# Test all major module imports
modules = [
    'nanobot.bus.queue',
    'nanobot.bus.events',
    'nanobot.channels.base',
    'nanobot.channels.registry',
    'nanobot.channels.telegram',
    'nanobot.groupchat.orchestra.engine',
    'nanobot.groupchat.orchestra.broadcast',
    'nanobot.groupchat.orchestra.run_loop',
    'nanobot.groupchat.orchestra.tools.chatroom_tools',
    'nanobot.groupchat.orchestra.tools.tool_loop',
    'nanobot.groupchat.history.context',
    'nanobot.groupchat.history.persistence',
    'nanobot.groupchat.history.prompt_builder',
    'nanobot.groupchat.history.result_processor',
    'nanobot.session.manager',
    'nanobot.heartbeat.service',
    'nanobot.utils.helpers',
    'nanobot.providers.base',
    'nanobot.providers.registry',
    'nanobot.providers.litellm_provider',
    'nanobot.tools.base',
    'nanobot.tools.process',
    'nanobot.tools.memory_palace',
    'nanobot.config.schema',
]
ok = 0
fail = 0
for m in modules:
    try:
        __import__(m)
        ok += 1
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'FAIL: {m} -> {e}')
        fail += 1
print(f'\n{ok}/{ok+fail} modules imported successfully')
" 2>&1
which nanobot && which nanogpt 2>/dev/null; ls /etc/systemd/system/nanobot* 2>/dev/null; ls /etc/systemd/system/nano* 2>/dev/null
